TEACHER_GROUND_TRUTH_locked.defender_pool: last ceil(N/2) living agents by index (size-normalized)
TEACHER_GROUND_TRUTH_locked.threat_order: living intruders ranked by distance to own flag home (nearest-home first); stable argsort by enemy index on ties
TEACHER_GROUND_TRUTH_locked.matching: for each threat in that order: assign nearest UNASSIGNED defender (continuous Euclidean); update `taken`; surplus defenders hold home
TEACHER_GROUND_TRUTH_locked.post: no chase past midline; clamp to defensive disc
TEACHER_GROUND_TRUTH_locked.NOT_hungarian_global: teacher uses sequential greedy with `taken`, not a global bipartite optimum — the diagnostic MUST reproduce THIS rule, not invent Hungarian unless an amendment freezes a deliberate alternative

CANDIDATE_z_i_v1_locked.principle: math decides responsibility; RL would later decide behavior — this diagnostic does not train RL
fields_allowed: responsibility_type in {DEFEND, ATTACK, HOLD} derived from the same defender-pool rule as the teacher (index band + alive)
assigned_entity_id (enemy index, or HOME sentinel when holding)
relative geometry to assigned entity: (Delta_x, Delta_y) and/or distance in continuous coords used by the core
FORBIDDEN_in_z_i: teacher (btx, bty) or W50 waypoint index q(t)
reward, return, pole id, opponent genome id
binary ROLE bit alone as a substitute for assigned_entity
CANDIDATE_z_i_v1_locked.hold_ticks: optional H_a (default 8) for stability in a FUTURE train arm; diagnostic primary metrics are evaluated on instantaneous assignment matching the teacher tick (H_a ablation may be reported as secondary)

G1_TEACHER_ASSIGNMENT_AGREEMENT.question: Does a pure-geometry implementation of TEACHER_GROUND_TRUTH reproduce the teacher's per-agent assigned entity / responsibility on recorded GUARD ticks?
G1_TEACHER_ASSIGNMENT_AGREEMENT.metric: Accuracy = (# agent-ticks where diagnostic assignment matches teacher sidecar assignment) / (# eligible agent-ticks)
G1_TEACHER_ASSIGNMENT_AGREEMENT.eligible: living blue agents on GUARD / BLUE_ONE_DEFENDER_V2 rollouts at N=4 (primary); N=2 negative control; N=6 optional severity
G1_TEACHER_ASSIGNMENT_AGREEMENT.PASS_floor_exploratory: Accuracy >= 0.95 on N=4 primary block (point estimate). Fail-closed: if G1 fails, the extractor is wrong — redesign code, do not train.
G1_TEACHER_ASSIGNMENT_AGREEMENT.note: Near-perfect G1 is expected if the extractor is a faithful lift of the teacher loop; G1 is a known-answer contract, not the scientific claim.

G2_RESOLVES_SEALED_AMBIGUITY.question: On the sealed ARM1 TEST_0 counterexample pairs (and/or natural o-collisions), does z_i differ whenever the teacher's projected target q(t) differs under byte-identical student observations?
